entries.name: Babel (Python)
entries.use_for: Python i18n: gettext message extraction plus CLDR date, number and currency formatting
entries.why: Standard Python i18n toolkit used by Flask-Babel, Sphinx and many frameworks
entries.summary: Babel is a Python library of utilities for internationalizing and localizing Python applications, particularly web applications. The README itself is brief and points to the docs and babel.pocoo.org for details.
entries.best_for: Adding i18n/l10n to Python (especially web) applications, such as locale-aware formatting and translation message catalogs.
entries.not_for: JavaScript or frontend i18n. The README gives few details itself, so check the docs for specific features before relying on them.

entries.name: Fluent.js
entries.use_for: Mozilla Fluent localization for JS, with natural-sounding grammar handling
entries.why: JS implementation of Mozilla's Fluent, the localization system used in Firefox
entries.summary: JavaScript implementation of Mozilla's Project Fluent localization system, with an easy-to-read syntax that handles complex natural-language grammar (plurals, gender).
entries.best_for: Apps needing translations that adapt to grammar rather than simple key-value strings, in the Mozilla Fluent style.
entries.not_for: Smaller ecosystem than i18next or ICU; translators must learn FTL syntax.

entries.name: FormatJS (react-intl)
entries.use_for: ICU message formatting, Intl polyfills and react-intl for React apps
entries.why: Home of react-intl and intl-messageformat, the reference ICU MessageFormat stack in JS; millions of weekly downloads

license_verified.note: Per-package licenses: most packages MIT; react-intl and intl-messageformat BSD-3-Clause

entries.summary: Monorepo for FormatJS and related JavaScript i18n libraries, published as separate npm packages. These include an ICU MessageFormat parser, a CLI for message extraction, and polyfills for Intl APIs such as DateTimeFormat, NumberFormat, ListFormat, DisplayNames and Locale.
entries.best_for: JavaScript/TypeScript apps that need ICU message formatting, message extraction tooling, or Intl API polyfills for older runtimes.
entries.not_for: Non-JavaScript stacks. The repo is a collection of many packages, so you have to pick the ones you need; the README mostly lists packages rather than explaining usage.

entries.name: go-i18n
entries.use_for: Translate Go programs into multiple languages with CLDR plural rules.
entries.why: The most used i18n package for Go, with a CLI to extract and merge messages.
entries.summary: Go package and CLI for translating Go programs, supporting pluralized strings for 200+ CLDR languages and named variables, with tooling to extract and merge messages.
entries.best_for: Go services and CLIs needing localized, pluralized messages.
entries.not_for: Go only and not a translation management platform; limited formatting beyond messages.

entries.name: i18next
entries.use_for: Framework-agnostic internationalization for JavaScript with plurals, interpolation and backends.
entries.why: The most widely used JS i18n core, with bindings for React, Vue, Node and many plugins.
entries.summary: Framework-agnostic JavaScript internationalization core with plurals, interpolation and pluggable backends, with bindings for React, Vue, Node and many plugins.
entries.best_for: Any JS app needing a flexible i18n runtime with a large plugin ecosystem.
entries.not_for: More configuration than compile-time libraries like Lingui; ICU format needs a plugin.

entries.name: ICU4X
entries.use_for: Modular Unicode/CLDR internationalization components for Rust, WASM and FFI
entries.summary: Unicode Consortium's modular, lightweight internationalization components for Rust, with bindings for WASM and other languages via FFI.
entries.best_for: Rust, WASM or embedded projects needing small-footprint Unicode and CLDR internationalization.
entries.not_for: Rust-first with a smaller API surface than ICU4C/ICU4J; not a translation workflow tool.

entries.name: Lingo.dev
entries.use_for: AI-powered localization CLI and SDK that translates app strings and content in CI.
entries.why: Automates translation of JSON/YAML/markdown files with LLMs; plugs into CI and many frameworks.
entries.summary: AI localization engineering platform with a CLI and SDK that translates app strings and content with LLMs, with CI integration and translation quality measurement.
entries.best_for: Teams automating translation of JSON, YAML or markdown content in CI.
entries.not_for: Relies on LLMs and a hosted platform for parts of the workflow; machine translations may need human review.

entries.name: Lingui
entries.use_for: Small, readable JS i18n with message extraction and compile-time catalogs.
entries.why: Compiles messages ahead of time for a tiny runtime; CLI handles extraction to PO/JSON.
entries.summary: Lightweight JS/TS i18n library, about 2 kB gzipped core, with compile-time macros and a CLI for message extraction. Works with React, React Native, Vue, Solid, Astro, Svelte and Node.
entries.best_for: Apps wanting a tiny runtime and readable source messages with extraction to PO or JSON.
entries.not_for: Requires build-time macro and compile step; ecosystem smaller than i18next.

entries.name: messageformat
entries.use_for: ICU MessageFormat and MessageFormat 2 parser/compiler for JS
entries.why: Reference JS implementation of Unicode MessageFormat 2
entries.summary: Monorepo with JS implementations of Unicode MessageFormat 2 and ICU MessageFormat for pluralization and gender handling across CLDR languages.
entries.best_for: Apps or libraries needing standards-based MessageFormat parsing and compilation.
entries.not_for: Low-level formatter, not a full i18n framework with loading, routing or extraction.

entries.name: next-intl
entries.use_for: Internationalization for Next.js, including App Router, routing and server components.
entries.why: The go-to i18n library for the Next.js App Router, with ICU messages and localized routing.
entries.summary: Internationalization library for Next.js with ICU message syntax, date/time/number formatting, App Router and server component support, and localized routing.
entries.best_for: Next.js App Router projects that need localized routing and typed ICU messages.
entries.not_for: Next.js only; not for other frameworks.

entries.name: next-translate
entries.use_for: Lightweight i18n for Next.js pages and app router
entries.why: Popular small i18n alternative for Next.js
entries.summary: Lightweight i18n plugin and API for Next.js pages and app router, loading translation namespaces per page.
entries.best_for: Next.js projects wanting a small i18n solution with per-page namespaces.
entries.not_for: Next.js only; richer features like ICU and localized routing are better covered by next-intl.

entries.name: ngx-translate
entries.why: Long-established Angular i18n library, simple JSON-based setup.
entries.summary: Runtime translation library for Angular using JSON translation files, with documentation covering Angular 16 to 21.
entries.best_for: Angular apps needing simple, runtime language switching from JSON files.
entries.not_for: Angular only; Transloco offers lazy-loaded scopes and richer tooling, and Angular built-in i18n is compile-time.

entries.name: Nuxt i18n
entries.use_for: I18n module for Nuxt with localized routes, SEO tags and lazy loading.
entries.why: Standard Nuxt module built on vue-i18n; handles locale routing for you.
entries.summary: Nuxt module integrating vue-i18n with static and dynamic route localization, lazy-loaded translations, and localized SEO tags.
entries.best_for: Nuxt apps needing multi-language routes and SEO handled automatically.
entries.not_for: Nuxt only; plain Vue apps should use vue-i18n directly.

entries.name: react-i18next
entries.use_for: React bindings for i18next: hooks, components and SSR support.
entries.why: Default i18n choice for React apps; shares the i18next plugin ecosystem.
entries.summary: React bindings for i18next offering hooks, components and SSR support, sharing the i18next plugin ecosystem.
entries.best_for: React apps that want i18next with hooks and server rendering.

entries.name: Ruby I18n
entries.use_for: Core Ruby internationalization API used by Rails
entries.summary: Core Ruby internationalization and localization gem with interpolation, CLDR-compatible pluralization, transliteration, flexible defaults and bulk lookup. Underlies Rails i18n.
entries.best_for: Ruby and Rails apps needing translation lookup and localized formatting.
entries.not_for: Ruby only; translation management and extraction need separate tools.

entries.name: Tolgee
entries.use_for: Self-hostable localization platform with in-context editing and machine translation
entries.why: Open-source TMS alternative to Crowdin/Lokalise with SDKs for major frameworks

license_verified.note: Apache-2.0 outside ee/ and webapp/src/ee; those under the Tolgee EE license

entries.summary: Open-source localization platform alternative to Crowdin, Phrase or Lokalise, self-hostable with in-context editing, machine translation and SDKs for major frameworks.
entries.best_for: Teams wanting a self-hostable translation management system with in-app editing.
entries.not_for: Heavier infrastructure than a library; hosted version is paid and it is a platform, not a runtime i18n library.

entries.name: Transloco
entries.use_for: Internationalization library for Angular with runtime language switching.
entries.why: Modern Angular i18n with lazy-loaded scopes and tooling; more flexible than built-in Angular i18n.
entries.summary: Angular internationalization library with runtime language switching, lazy-loaded scopes and tooling. Packages are published under @jsverse.
entries.best_for: Angular apps needing runtime language switching and lazy-loaded translations.
entries.not_for: Angular only; you must update dependencies to the @jsverse scope.

entries.name: Vue I18n
entries.why: The standard Vue i18n library, with Composition API support.
entries.summary: Internationalization plugin for Vue 3 from the Intlify project with Composition API support. Notes that v11 continues to be maintained.
entries.best_for: Vue 3 apps needing standard i18n with message formatting.
entries.not_for: Vue only; Nuxt projects typically add the nuxt i18n module for routing.

entries.name: Weblate
entries.use_for: Self-hosted web translation management system tightly integrated with Git.
entries.why: Mature open-source TMS used by many large projects; continuous localization straight from your repo.
entries.summary: Privacy-respecting, open-source web localization platform integrated with Git for continuous localization. Can be self-hosted or used as hosted Weblate.
entries.best_for: Projects needing a collaborative, self-hosted translation management system tied to a repository.
entries.not_for: Server application with ops overhead; not a runtime i18n library.
